text:
I need to verify if Peter Frampton wrote "Here Comes My Baby" for the Tremeloes at age 18.

"Here Comes My Baby" was actually written by Cat Stevens (now known as Yusuf Islam), not Peter Frampton. Cat Stevens wrote this song when he was around 18 years old in 1967, and it became a hit for the Tremeloes that same year.

Peter Frampton is indeed an English singer/songwriter/musician, but he did not write this particular song.

Verdict: INCORRECT
Confidence: 0.99
